title: 第22章 排位赛前的损招
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
备战的两周，安槐把时间掰成了三瓣用。

    白天上课，下午陪苏念念练功，晚上回家修炼固元淬体诀。

    六重之后的修炼速度明显慢了下来，但经脉的韧性和灵气运转效率都在稳步提升，每一天都比前一天强一点。

    这天傍晚，练功房里只剩安槐和苏念念两个人。

    苏念念练了一套断岳拳，收势的时候额头全是汗，胸口起伏着，眼神亮得像两颗星。

    “再来一次。”

    “老大今天已经打了七套了。”

    “我不累。”

    “你的手在抖。”

    苏念念低头看了一眼自己微微发颤的手指，嘴角一撇。

    “这叫兴奋。”

    安槐没拆穿她，走过去把水瓶递到她手里。

    “休息十分钟再说。”

    苏念念灌了两口水，一屁股坐在减震垫上，仰头看他。

    “安槐，排位赛你准备怎么打？”

    “看分组再说。”

    “我是说，你打算拿第几？”

    安槐想了想。“前三吧，A级药池的使用权挺有用的。”

    “那我呢？你觉得我能拿第几？”

    安槐蹲下来，跟她平视。

    “看你这两周的训练成果，三式到四式的衔接已经比半个月前快了一倍，但还不够。”

    苏念念皱眉。“哪里不够？”

    “你的变招虽然能打破节奏断层，但每次变招之后都要重新蓄力，中间有将近半秒的空白，碰到比你强的对手，半秒够挨两拳了。”

    苏念念低头琢磨了几秒，猛地抬头。

    “那我怎么办？”

    安槐伸出右手，五指微微张开。

    “打我一拳。”

    “啊？”

    “打我肩膀。”

    苏念念狐疑地看了他两秒，站起来，干脆利落地一拳轰向他右肩。

    安槐没躲。

    拳头砸在他肩上，他整个人往后退了半步，但左手同时扣住了苏念念的拳面，手掌包裹着她的拳头，顺着力量的方向轻轻一推。

    苏念念感觉自己的拳劲在接触的瞬间被卸掉了七成，剩下的三成力沿着安槐的手臂转了个弯，反弹回来推在了自己的小臂上。

    她的眼睛猛地亮了。

    “这是什么？”

    “借力打力。”安槐松开她的拳头，“固元淬体诀里有一个辅助手法叫回流掌，核心思路是把对方的力道吃进来再吐出去，我改了一下路线，跟断岳拳的发力方式互补。”

    “你什么时候研究的？”
content_en:
During the two weeks of preparation for the war, An Huai divided his time into three parts.

He went to class during the day, practiced with Su Niannian in the afternoon, and went home to practice the Yuan-Reinforcing Body Tempering Technique at night.

The speed of cultivation after the sixth level has obviously slowed down, but the toughness of the meridians and the efficiency of spiritual energy operation are steadily improving, and each day is a little stronger than the previous day.

That evening, An Huai and Su Niannian were the only two people left in the practice room.

Su Niannian practiced a set of Duanyue Fist. When she finished, her forehead was covered with sweat, her chest was heaving, and her eyes were as bright as two stars.

"Do it again."

"Boss has already played seven sets today."

"I'm not tired."

"Your hands are shaking."

Su Niannian looked down at her slightly trembling fingers and curled her lips.

"It's called excitement."

An Huai didn't expose her, walked over and handed the water bottle into her hand.

"Ten minutes before we talk."

Su Niannian took two gulps of water, sat down on the shock-absorbing pad, and looked up at him.

"An Huai, how are you going to play in the qualifying match?"

"Let's talk about the grouping."

"I mean, where are you going to finish?"

An Huai thought for a while."Top three, the right to use the A-level medicine pool is quite useful."

"What about me? Where do you think I can get?"

An Huai knelt down and looked at her level.

"Looking at your training results in the past two weeks, the transition from form three to form four has been twice as fast as half a month ago, but it's not enough."

Su Niannian frowned."What's not enough?"

"Although your changes of moves can break the rhythm gap, you have to recharge your energy after each change of moves. There is a gap of nearly half a second. If you encounter an opponent who is stronger than you, half a second is enough to receive two punches."

Su Niannian lowered her head and pondered for a few seconds, then raised her head suddenly.

"What should I do?"

An Huai stretched out his right hand and spread his fingers slightly.

"Punch me."

"Huh?"

"Hit me on the shoulder."

Su Niannian looked at him suspiciously for two seconds, stood up, and punched his right shoulder with a clean punch.

An Huai didn't hide.

The fist hit his shoulder, and he took half a step back, but at the same time, his left hand clasped Su Niannian's fist, wrapped his palm around her fist, and pushed gently in the direction of the force.

Su Niannian felt that 70% of her fist strength was removed at the moment of contact, and the remaining 30% of the force turned along An Huai's arm, rebounded and pushed on her forearm.

Her eyes suddenly lit up.

"What is this?"

"Leveraging strength to strike." An Huai released her fist. "There is an auxiliary technique in the Guyuan Body Tempering Technique called Return Palm. The core idea is to take in the opponent's strength and then spit it out. I changed the route to complement the force exertion method of Duanyue Fist."

"When did you study it?"
